title: Secret watermark labels proteins as ‘made by AI’
title_zh: 秘密水印将蛋白质标记为“由人工智能制造”
abstract: An innovative safeguard could help to flag proteins devised by artificial-intelligence tools such as AlphaFold, but the digital marker can be erased.
abstract_zh: 一种创新的安全措施可能有助于识别由 AlphaFold 等人工智能工具设计的蛋白质，但该数字标记可以被擦除。
snippet: An innovative safeguard could help to flag proteins devised by artificial-intelligence tools such as AlphaFold, but the digital marker can be erased.
